children.name: JSON profiles: program = wsl for Ubuntu shell commands; other programs use explicit argument arrays. Add profiles for any installed simulator, ROS node or AI service.

children.value:
{
  "distro": "Ubuntu-24.04",
  "profiles": [
    {
      "id": "sih",
      "name": "PX4 / SIH",
      "category": "Simulation",
      "description": "Lightweight internal flight physics · Quad X",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [
        "cd /home/hp/PX4-Autopilot && test -z \"$(pgrep -x px4)\" && make px4_sitl sihsim_quadx"
      ],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "test -x /home/hp/PX4-Autopilot/build/px4_sitl_default/bin/px4",
      "docs": "https://docs.px4.io/main/en/sim_sih/",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "relay",
      "name": "WSL display relay",
      "category": "Infrastructure",
      "description": "SIH state → native Windows visualizer · UDP 19410",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [
        "python3 -u \"$DRONE_DECK_SCRIPTS/relay.py\""
      ],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "command -v python3",
      "docs": "https://docs.px4.io/main/en/sim_sih/",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "jmavsim",
      "name": "jMAVSim",
      "category": "Simulation",
      "description": "Native Java visualizer · display only",
      "program": "java",
      "args": [
        "--add-exports",
        "java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED",
        "--add-exports",
        "java.desktop/sun.awt=ALL-UNNAMED",
        "--add-exports",
        "java.desktop/sun.java2d=ALL-UNNAMED",
        "-XX:GCTimeRatio=20",
        "-Djava.ext.dirs=",
        "-jar",
        "jmavsim_run.jar",
        "-udp",
        "19410",
        "-disponly"
      ],
      "cwd": "C:\\Users\\HP\\Desktop\\Simulator Launchers\\jMAVSim-Windows",
      "probe": "C:\\Users\\HP\\Desktop\\Simulator Launchers\\jMAVSim-Windows\\jmavsim_run.jar",
      "docs": "https://docs.px4.io/main/en/sim_jmavsim/",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "gazebo",
      "name": "Gazebo Harmonic",
      "category": "Simulation",
      "description": "PX4 X500 · low graphics world · heavier GPU load",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [
        "cd /home/hp/PX4-Autopilot && test -z \"$(pgrep -x px4)\" && export PX4_GZ_WORLD=default_low && make px4_sitl gz_x500"
      ],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "command -v gz && test -d /home/hp/PX4-Autopilot",
      "docs": "https://gazebosim.org/docs/harmonic/",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "qgc",
      "name": "QGroundControl",
      "category": "Flight operations",
      "description": "Vehicle setup, missions and flight control",
      "program": "C:\\Program Files\\QGroundControl\\bin\\QGroundControl.exe",
      "args": [
        "-swrast"
      ],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "C:\\Program Files\\QGroundControl\\bin\\QGroundControl.exe",
      "docs": "https://docs.qgroundcontrol.com/master/en/qgc-user-guide/getting_started/download_and_install.html",
      "download_url": "https://github.com/mavlink/qgroundcontrol/releases/download/v5.1.5/QGroundControl-installer-AMD64.exe",
      "exclusive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "telemetry",
      "name": "MAVSDK telemetry",
      "category": "Development",
      "description": "Read-only live vehicle data · uses UDP 14540",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [
        "'/mnt/c/Users/HP/Desktop/DroneProjects/px4-mavsdk-starter/.venv/bin/python' -u \"$DRONE_DECK_SCRIPTS/telemetry.py\""
      ],
      "cwd": "C:\\Users\\HP\\Desktop\\DroneProjects\\px4-mavsdk-starter",
      "probe": "test -x '/mnt/c/Users/HP/Desktop/DroneProjects/px4-mavsdk-starter/.venv/bin/python'",
      "docs": "https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/main/en/python/",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "ros2",
      "name": "ROS 2 Jazzy",
      "category": "Development",
      "description": "ROS graph discovery · configure your node command",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [
        "source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && ros2 topic list"
      ],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "test -f /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash",
      "docs": "https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/Installation/Ubuntu-Install-Debs.html",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "dds",
      "name": "Micro XRCE-DDS Agent",
      "category": "Infrastructure",
      "description": "PX4 ↔ ROS 2 transport · UDP 8888",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [
        "MicroXRCEAgent udp4 -p 8888"
      ],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "command -v MicroXRCEAgent",
      "docs": "https://docs.px4.io/main/en/middleware/uxrce_dds",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "ardupilot",
      "name": "ArduPilot SITL",
      "category": "Simulation",
      "description": "Alternative flight stack · configure checkout path",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [
        "cd ~/ardupilot && Tools/autotest/sim_vehicle.py -v ArduCopter --no-mavproxy"
      ],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "test -x ~/ardupilot/Tools/autotest/sim_vehicle.py",
      "docs": "https://ardupilot.org/dev/docs/sitl-simulator-software-in-the-loop.html",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "ai",
      "name": "AI pipeline",
      "category": "AI & data",
      "description": "Configure your inference, training or dataset command",
      "program": "wsl",
      "args": [],
      "cwd": "",
      "probe": "",
      "docs": "https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/",
      "download_url": "",
      "exclusive": false
    }
  ]
}
